title: Intake Triage Scorer
dek: Intakegate is a triage pipeline I built for messages to a children's therapy service: it proposes how soon a person should review each one, from P0, same-hour review, to P3, the lowest. This page runs its scorer, rule for rule: two safety gates, then a points total, over every combination it reads.
summary: All 12,672 signal combinations scored: shouting “URGENT” never moves a message’s priority, and once a safety gate fires, nothing else does.
